summary_text: Based on the RedSeer Report commissioned for this offer, the Indian economy is projected to grow at an annual real GDP rate of 9% between 2020 and 2025, reaching a market size of $4.2 trillion. The primary growth drivers include favorable demographic trends with 700 million Gen Z and millennials, expanding urbanization reaching 550 million by FY2026, and a rising middle class expected to push private consumption to $2.5 trillion by 2025. Leveraging these strong macroeconomic tailwinds and third-party market validation, One97 Communications (Paytm) is strategically positioned to capture increasing consumer spending and accelerated digital penetration across the Indian market.

According to the commissioned Frost & Sullivan report dated June 17, 2026, the global economy is projected to expand by approximately 3.2% in 2025, with emerging markets like India outperforming advanced nations. Key macro drivers accelerating industry dynamics include global supply chain diversification away from China, green and digital transitions, and favorable demographic trends in developing regions. Lohia Corp Limited operates within the specialized machinery sector for technical textiles, focusing on woven fabric and sack production to capture growth from shifting global manufacturing hubs.

According to the RedSeer Report, India's economy is projected to rebound sharply with 11% to 11.5% GDP growth in Fiscal 2022, reaching an estimated US$4.4 trillion by 2025. Key industry drivers include a young workforce with a median age of 28, expanding urbanization expected to reach 37% by 2025, and rapidly surging mobile internet penetration. These macroeconomic and digital tailwinds position consumer technology platforms to capture expanding service-oriented urban consumption across India.
